description: A library of named edits an agent adds to footage, each with what it looks like, when to use it, the common mistake and how to build it in FFmpeg, HyperFrames, Remotion and CapCut. Cuts and pacing (J-cut, L-cut, match cut, speed ramp), transitions (whip pan, zoom, glitch, light leak, masks, FFmpeg xfade, Remotion and shader transitions), words on screen (headlines, callouts, lower thirds, reviews, end cards and CTAs), showing a product (UI walkthroughs, cursor clicks, device mockups, code and terminal screens, agent flows) and visuals (counters and charts, logo walls, grids and carousels, backdrops). Use when someone asks for a transition, a cut, a title, a lower third, a testimonial, an end card, a CTA, a screen-recording zoom, a cursor, a phone or laptop mockup, a code or terminal animation, an animated number or chart, a logo wall or a background while editing a video. Not for choosing an editing service (use varg-video-editing) or generating new footage (varg-ai).
